name: kd768_lp_multidisease_rfmid_odir
input: L2-normalised KD768 embedding (768-d). z = emb / max(norm(emb), 1e-12)
score: sigmoid(dot(w_folded, z) + b_folded). StandardScaler already folded into w_folded/b_folded. Do NOT also apply scaler_mean/scaler_scale if using w_folded.
preprocessing: crop_fundus(thr=15, 5x5 open, square pad) -> 640 INTER_AREA -> 512 INTER_AREA -> RGB ImageNet mean/std -> student -> L2
protocol: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(class_weight='balanced', max_iter=3000); C tuned in [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1.0] by 3-fold StratifiedKFold(rs=0) AUROC. Shared RFMiD+ODIR heads use equal dataset weighting w_i = N/(2*n_dataset). DR is reused from kd768_lp_dr_rfmid_odir_aptos.joblib head_balanced (RFMiD+ODIR+APTOS, not refit).
recommended_threshold_note: thr_youden_cv is high-sensitivity and can be very low for rare diseases (false alarms). Prefer thr_prev_cv (prevalence-matched / higher-specificity) or a 0.50 floor for rare-disease UI flags. p_prior_adj = sigmoid(logit + log(pi/(1-pi))) with pi=train_prev is a prevalence-calibrated probability.

Disease_Risk.weighting: sample_weight = N / (2 * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/2, mean weight=1

DR.weighting: sample_weight = N / (n_datasets * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/3, mean weight=1

ARMD.weighting: sample_weight = N / (2 * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/2, mean weight=1

MYA.weighting: sample_weight = N / (2 * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/2, mean weight=1

DN.weighting: sample_weight = N / (2 * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/2, mean weight=1

LS.weighting: sample_weight = N / (2 * n_dataset); each dataset sums to N/2, mean weight=1
